after: Gentle meditation or self-hypnosis is a different story. It can really calm your nervous system down, so the guards often ease off on their own, slowly enough for the grown-up in you to keep up. A lot of people find that a mantra they feel some heart connection to, repeated in their head or out loud, especially with a nice melody, can lower the walls enough for the heart to open up. It's not something to lean on all day as a way of coping, but used as therapy it can be super effective.
